rule.content: predeclared ASCII text about typesetting punctuation; explicitly NON_EVIDENCE, no packing advice, measured numbers or invented claims
rule.factor: relevant evidence vs unrelated additional prompt content
rule.length: canonical JSON entry chars AND UTF-8 bytes exactly equal paired E fragment; array overhead identical; tolerance zero
rule.mutability: one deterministic version; no alternate seeds or result-dependent reconstruction
rule.residual_difference: different fields/meaning and repetitive filler; equal bytes do not equate tokens, attention or semantic information
rule.selection: same frozen E public query, source exclusions, ranking and whole-entry budgets; replace admitted E fragment by paired placebo
